Two people got into a car accident at the corner today, one of the drivers was a 18 year old and the other driver a 48 year old. The 48 year old had been going 55mph in a 30mph zone and wasn't able to stop in time to avoid hitting the 18 year old when he came to a full stop at the stop sign. Who was acting recklessly?
A. The 48 year old
B. Not enough info
C. The 18 year old
